_Do you also feel energized by super smooth Operations and a beautiful CI/CD setup? Do you eat Kubernetes and Azure for breakfast? And do you thrive in a sometimes-unpredictable environment where you jump in and save the day? Then we believe we have something great to offer.

__We are looking for an experienced Azure, Kubernetes, and CI/CD Engineer to help elevate our SaaS operations and internal deployment processes to the next level.

_**Key About Your Role

**We aim to take Operations to the next level by onboarding more skilled human power (you) and using your expertise to refine and modernize our existing Azure setup. The goal is to make it more elegant, clean, and scalable.

As a central figure in the infrastructure everyone depends on, communication and collaboration will be a natural part of your work. You will provide ad hoc support to colleagues and customer representatives, contributing directly to the stability and growth of our platform.

We work with two layers of deployments:

• Platform deployments: Low frequency (around once per month), planned well in advance

• Customer component deployments: Higher frequency (around once per week), shorter planning horizon

Both typically take place outside normal office hours. For these, you will be compensated with time off from your regular schedule. Deployments usually last about 15 minutes, with occasional on-call backup needed for unforeseen issues (fortunately, rare).

Your work will revolve around three main areas as follows:

****Key responsibilities:

• Environments: Refining and improving the setup of our internal and external environments in a beautiful Kubernetes architecture in Azure

• CI/CD: Configuring, maintaining and continuously improving our entire CI/CD universe

• Operations: Participate actively in operations tasks, maintenance windows, deployments, and incident debugging. Together with the small operations team, ensure our platform runs smoothly 24/7

There is a lot more behind the Platform than a simple list of tools can show. Instead of giving you a long inventory, we would rather have an informal conversation where we can explore the details together.

**Key About Your Team

**Our team, named Obex, is a business unit of Keylane, employing around twenty-five awesome developers, business analysts and a few other professions. Our main product is our Obex Platform, a SaaS solution for financial advisory used by advisors in a variety of pension funds and banks.

We are proud that finances of an estimated two million Danes have been through our software. The Obex Platform is developed in close collaboration with our customers, resulting in a product that users truly appreciate.

In Obex we care for each other. Thriving is top priority. You will feel that atmosphere as soon as you enter.

Our organization is flat, the best argument wins, not the highest title. We do things because they make sense. If something stops making sense, we stop doing it, whether that's a process, a line of code, or a piece of architecture. We aim for the best solutions, not for rigid conformity.

We believe in mutual elasticity: We go the extra mile to support you, each other, and our customers. And we expect the same spirit in return. Together, we share responsibility for keeping the Obex machine running smoothly.

There's much more to tell about our way of working, our culture, and our social side (fun activities and parties included), but let's save that for a chat, either online or over a great cup of coffee.

**Questions?

**If you have any further questions regarding this position, please reach out to the hiring manager Rasmus Amossen via mail to rasmus.amossen@keylane.com.

When you have any general questions about Keylane or want to have a quick chat before applying, just reach out to Talent Acquisition Specialist Thomas Thomsen via mail to thomas.thomsen@keylane.com.

**Requirements

****Experience?

**

• You are fluent in Kubernetes, have solid experience with Azure services, virtual network configuration, and Azure DevOps

• You know your way around log and performance monitoring tools and have a passion for clean, well-architected systems

• You are not content with things merely working, you want them to work beautifully

• Our platform uses .NET on the backend, React with Typescript on the frontend, and Aspire for local development orchestration. Experience with these technologies is a plus.

• There is a lot more behind the Platform than a simple list of tools can show. Instead of giving you a long inventory, we would rather have an informal conversation where we can explore the details together

**Using AI

**

• You are interested in using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Codex as part of the software development lifecycle. For example, to explore solutions, understand unfamiliar code, generate or improve code and tests, refactoring, troubleshoot issues, document solutions and support code reviews;

• You understand that AI-generated code and suggestions must be critically evaluated, tested and reviewed. You take ownership of the quality, security, correctness and maintainability of the code you deliver;

**Other

**Please send your application with CV via our website. Applications are evaluated continuously

A criminal record and reference check are part of the application process. Each employee within Keylane must follow training on information security and irrespective to the role basic information security responsibilities apply.

**Benefits

**

• A flat and informal organization with a professional and supportive working environment

• A profit share

• Inclusion days where you decide when to hold your public holidays

• Five weeks of vacation and five Keylane days

• A pension scheme where 13.25% is paid by Keylane and the individual contribution is 3%

• Flexibility in the working environment. We offer a combination of working from home and from the office. We value seeing colleagues in person to stay connected and collaborate effectively

• The Danish office is located a 10-minute walk from Islands Brygge Metro station

• We believe that strong employee relations are key to maintaining well-being in the workplace. To support this, we offer a variety of social activities that all employees can participate in, such as yoga, padel tennis, running, outdoor bathing, and fitness in the basement

• Salary: For this role, the Monthly Base Salary ranges from 43.000 - 56.000 (DKK), corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate's skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT FOR US

**We are seeking a Delivery Excellence Principal – Securities Operations to help shape the future of our operational platform and delivery model, with reconciliation excellence as a core capability. You will join a small, high‑impact team within a large organization, with a clear mandate to influence how Securities Operations scale. This role is designed for someone who combines deep securities operations knowledge and strong reconciliation expertise with the drive to turn complex problems into implemented scalable solutions. Acting as a catalyst for change, you will work across teams to streamline onboarding, industrialize reconciliation, and elevate platform usage - partnering closely with operational teams to enable delivery at scale. With significant autonomy and visibility, you will help move Securities Operations from bespoke execution to controlled, automated, and industrialized excellence.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Drive high‑impact delivery initiatives from idea to implementation.

• Design and embed best‑practice reconciliation models across asset classes.

• Reduce manual breaks through automation, standardization, and stronger controls.

• Enable teams through knowledge sharing, coaching, and clear solution design.

• Act as a platform authority on the SimCorp platform and influence best‑practice usage.

• Translate operational challenges into concrete solutions and process improvements.

• Lead complex client onboardings with a focus on scalable, repeatable setups.

• Define and maintain standards, documentation, and governance to ensure reuse and scale.

**What We Value

**

• Strong experience in investment operations within asset management, banking, or insurance.

• Proven hands‑on expertise on the SimCorp platform with a solution‑oriented mindset.

• Deep understanding of reconciliation processes across multiple asset classes.

• A track record of turning complex operational challenges into implemented outcomes.

• Ability to influence and drive change as part of a small, high‑impact team in a complex organization.

• A delivery‑focused mindset with passion for efficiency, scalability, and continuous improvement.

**Benefits

**Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work and work-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. And opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

**Your impact begins here

**As Sr Accounting & Digitalisation Partner, you will shape how accounting works across Business Area(BA) West. You will spot where processes can be simpler, more standardised and more automated, then work with colleagues in Accounting, Finance and IT to make those changes real. You will be the Accounting expert in the team, providing guidance on complect accounting issues. Across nine affiliates in 11 countries, your work will give colleagues better tools, a smoother user experience and more time for high-quality financial management.

**What You’ll Bring

**

• A master’s degree in business, finance, economics or a similar field.

• 8–10 years of relevant experience from finance, consulting or a related environment, including accounting, finance transformation, process management or digitalisation.

• A strong understanding of accounting processes and the needs of internal stakeholders.

• Experience driving process improvement, standardisation or digitalisation initiatives.

• Project experience and the ability to work across functions and organisational levels.

• Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder-management skills.

• A structured, proactive approach, with the ability to turn business needs into practical improvements.

• A collaborative mindset and the confidence to challenge existing ways of working constructively.

• Experience in emerging technologies, including how AI and automation can improve finance processes, decision support and ways of working.

**What You’ll Do

**

• You will be the link between central initiatives, accounting expertise and what the business needs day to day. Your focus will be on:

• Finding opportunities to digitalise, automate and simplify accounting processes, and proposing improvements that raise efficiency, quality, compliance and user experience.

• Driving standardisation and alignment of processes, tools and ways of working across Business Area West.

• Supporting the implementation of central initiatives as a strategic partner, and leading projects that draw on your accounting and process expertise.

• Providing process and accounting sparring to colleagues.

• Taking ownership, governance and continuous development of your assigned area.

• Be the link between Accounting Manager, Controller and out Global Shared Service centre in Bangalore

• Building strong relationships with stakeholders across Accounting, Finance, IT and the wider business.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the Accounting & Taxation Centre of Excellence for BA West, based in Ørestad, Copenhagen, and report to the Associate Director Accounting & Taxation COE. The team is responsible for accounting and taxation for the nine affiliates and provides expertise, governance and support across accounting, tax, compliance and process excellence.

The team includes Accounting Managers and controllers who work as dedicated finance partners to individual affiliates. You and one colleague focus on Business Area West as a whole. Your affiliates cover Denmark & Iceland, Sweden, Norway, Switzerland, the Netherlands, Belgium & Luxembourg, Finland, Ireland and Portugal.

You will work closely with colleagues in Accounting, Finance, IT and the wider business to turn ideas into standardised, efficient ways of working. Challenging the status quo constructively, and speaking up when things are stalling, is part of how this team moves forward.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will be trusted to own your area and make your voice heard, with real scope to shape how accounting works across eleven countries. You will build new skills by working across finance, IT and the business, and by exploring how AI and automation can improve finance processes. You will be supported to perform at your best and grow alongside your colleagues.

• Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 742,560.00 to 1,091,600.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to be a trusted accounting partner and to make accounting simpler, smarter and more digital across Business Area West, apply for the Sr Accounting & Digitalisation Partner role by 19.11.2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

****Job Description:

****Are you ready to drive change, foster a culture of commercial excellence, and lead strategic transformation projects? As the Regional Perfo & Transformation Manager at Satair, you will act as the primary representative for the Commercial Process, Performance & Transformation (ASCX) team in your region. You will bridge the gap between regional teams and the central ASCX pillars of processes, performance, data analytics, and automation to support Satair's commercial objectives. We are looking for a structured, results-oriented leader who can influence without authority and advocate for the region's needs within a complex, shared Airbus ecosystem.

**What The Job Is

**You will report to the Head of Commercial Data Analytics (HO ASCXY) and integrate into a multi-disciplinary team spread across the globe. In this role, you will serve as the regional node for a centralized cross-functional team, meaning you will not have direct reports but will lead by influence across regional commercial teams, account directors, and operations.

Your main responsibilities:

• Regional Commercial Project Portfolio Leadership: Accountable for the regional commercial project portfolio's financial impact and performance metrics, leading transformation projects using LBIP and Agile methodologies.

• Regional AOS Roadmap Execution: Take accountability for the successful implementation of the AOS (Airbus Operating System) regional roadmap in alignment with ASCX and the Regional Managing Director.

• Regional Representation & Connectivity: Act as a critical connector between regional teams and ASCX, representing ASCX in the Regional Customer Satisfaction Review Board (R-CSRB) and other commercial forums.

• Culture & Continuous Improvement: Proactively drive a culture of creativity, commercial excellence, and continuous improvement by identifying and addressing systemic "irritants".

Travel days to be expected are approximately 30% (domestic and international).

**How You Will Contribute To The Team

**We are looking for a proactive professional with an excellent problem-solving mindset and an ability to translate data into actionable insights. You must possess a keen understanding of business issues, key stakeholders, and external dynamics which inform priority setting.

You must hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, or a related field, accompanied by 5-10 years of proven experience leading cross-functional, regional, and global continuous improvement and transformation projects in a complex setting. A strong understanding of aviation aftermarket commercial operations is highly preferred, as are additional certifications in process improvement methodologies (e.g., Six Sigma, Lean). You will thrive in this role if you possess a high degree of agility in learning, exceptional communication and presentation abilities, and a proactive "can-do attitude". Because you will be networking globally, an excellent command of both written and spoken English is required, while proficiency in a secondary language relevant to the assigned region is preferred.

**What does your next challenge look like?

**At SATAIR, we believe in sustainable aviation that allows people to travel and connect across the globe.

We are on a mission to provide world class material solutions that keep aircraft flying and extend their lifespan.

In Satair, you can challenge the status quo, pioneer new ways of working, and generate real value for airlines and suppliers worldwide.

Being part of the Airbus family gives us the opportunity to live a global mindset, working in international and diverse teams and collaborating across functions, sites and cultures.

If you want to work as one team embracing a can-do attitude in a demanding environment, then we offer a great place to explore, learn, and grow, making an impact on aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company!

**About SATAIR

**Satair is an Airbus Services company offering first-class material management solutions in the aviation aftermarket industry. We take pride in delivering an excellent customer experience around the clock, driving innovation, and contributing to aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

With our global functional organisation spanning 12 sites and locations worldwide, and a team of over 2,000 people supporting a $3.9 billion turnover, you will be part of a truly global company that continues to grow year after year.

Welcome to the Satair family!

If you want to know more about our business, have a closer look at our website www.SATAIR.com or check out our SATAIR Youtube Channel at www.youtube.com/sataircompany !

**What do we offer at SATAIR?

**At SATAIR, you will find much more than a job - we offer you the possibility of growing both your personal and professional capacities in a fun, supportive and informal working environment, where you will be encouraged to engage, share knowledge and ideas.

SATAIR is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We love to bring in people with different backgrounds and experiences as we believe it enhances our performance immensely!

Here is a selection of some of the benefits we offer our employees in Copenhagen:

Financial Benefits: Competitive salary, Employee Stock Ownership Program, Success sharing, Health insurance, Group accident insurance, Employee discounts to local businesses

Employee Health and Wellbeing: On-site gym, App-based health & wellbeing platform, Amazing canteen at a subsided price, Massage scheme

Learning and Development: Airbus Leadership University, Large number of e-learning and training offers for personal and professional development, Promotion of professional development (e.g. postgraduate studies, technician training), Possibility of mentoring, Gain international experience

Work-life blend and life phase support: Possibility to work remotely, 4 care days, Senior days, Working from home policy (2 days remote per week)

**Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company

**Please send us your application as soon as possible to get the opportunity to become part of an exceptional global team!

We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

When applying for the position, you accept our data privacy statement: http://www.SATAIR.com/privacy

Legal Counsels for Legal & Compliance department at Novo Nordisk Engineering

If you’re energised by varied legal and compliance work and you thrive on supporting some of the world’s largest pharma engineering projects, we’d love to hear from you!

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

We are looking for two Legal Counsels to join our Legal & Compliance team in Virum, Denmark. You will join a small, dedicated team of colleagues who daily provides timely, commercially relevant legal and compliance advice that enables our line of business to deliver complex engineering projects.

Your role is key in ensuring that NNE navigates complex legal, contractual, and compliance matters effectively, while supporting our colleagues and projects across Denmark, India, and the US. You will report directly to the General Counsel, who heads the Legal & Compliance team globally.

This is a generalist, hands-on role where your time split roughly equally between legal and compliance work. You will see the practical impact of your advice across the organisation, and you will be given responsibility from the outset, while working alongside experienced colleagues who will support your continued development.

If you are qualified as a Danish attorney (advokat), you can retain your practising certificate in this role.

How you might spend your days

As a Legal Counsel, you’ll be:

• Drafting, reviewing and negotiating consultancy agreements and a wide range of other commercial contracts, including supplier, software, framework and data processing agreements

• Advising projects on contractual matters, change orders and claims

• Driving key elements of our compliance programme across business ethics, data protection, confidentiality and AI governance, including internal audits

• Developing and maintaining legal and compliance policies, standards and procedures

• Delivering training and awareness activities across the business

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• Taking ownership from the outset, act proactively and look for solutions.

• Collaborating effectively across projects, disciplines and geographies. You build strong, trust-based relationships with stakeholders across the organisation.

• Delivering high-quality work on time and know how to prioritise when things move quickly. You balance legal requirements, business realities and risk.

• Curious, keen to learn and look for ways to improve how we work. You approach new and complex matters with an open mind and challenge constructively when needed.

• Working independently and in a structured way. Your commercial mindset and genuine interest in NNE’s business enable you to provide pragmatic and legally robust advice.

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• A master’s degree in law (cand.jur.) or business law (cand.merc.jur.) or an equivalent legal qualification

• Around 3-5 years of experience from a law firm and/or an in-house legal function

• A broad legal foundation and an interest in working across different areas of law and compliance

• Excellent written and spoken English

• A responsible, curious approach to AI and new technology.

Life at NNE.

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 22 November 2026.

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact General Counsel Maj-Britt Nedergaard Larsen at +45 30 77 45 63 to arrange a call.

Please note:

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

Fair hiring:

At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

**The Impact You'll Make

**At Danfoss Sensing Solutions, we develop advanced sensing technologies supporting applications across the Danfoss portfolio. As demand for data centre infrastructure, energy-efficient cooling, and environmental monitoring continues to grow, we are expanding our capabilities to develop the next generation of sensing solutions.

As our Senior Mechanical Engineer, you will strengthen our mechanical engineering expertise within R&D and play an important role in developing future sensing platforms, with a particular focus on gas sensing and data centre applications.

You will help transform new ideas into robust, manufacturable products by driving mechanical architecture and packaging development from early concepts through industrialization. You will also provide technical expertise across mechanical design, packaging, and manufacturability while working closely with colleagues across multiple engineering disciplines.

This is an individual contributor role without people management responsibilities. Instead, your impact will come through technical leadership, influencing engineering decisions, sharing best practices, and strengthening our mechanical engineering capabilities.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**You will lead mechanical development activities across innovation and new product development projects, ensuring solutions are technically robust, scalable, and aligned with customer needs.

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Leading the mechanical architecture and design of next-generation sensing platforms, including housings, packaging, mounting concepts, and system integration.

• Developing robust encapsulation, sealing, and environmental protection solutions for sensors operating under demanding industrial conditions

• Driving mechanical work packages in innovation and product development projects in close collaboration with sensing specialists, electronics, firmware, manufacturing engineers, product management, and external partners.

• Developing mechanical concepts for gas sensing and data centre applications, including thermal management, fluid interfaces, installation concepts, and system-level solutions.

• Supporting prototyping, design reviews, risk assessments, testing activities, and supplier collaboration to enable successful industrialization.

**What We're Looking For

**You have a strong foundation in mechanical engineering combined with hands-on product development experience. You are comfortable taking ownership of complex mechanical challenges while collaborating across engineering disciplines.

To be successful in this role, we are looking for:

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline.

• Extensive experience developing industrial products from concept through production, including complex mechanical design challenges.

• Hands-on experience with mechanical design of sensors, electronic products, or other highly integrated mechanical systems.

• Strong experience with 3D CAD tools such as Inventor.

• Experience with injection-moulded components and Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) principles.

**It Would Be An Advantage If You Also Have

**

• Experience with sensor technology and sensor packaging.

• Knowledge within areas such as sealing and joining technologies, thermal management, tolerance analysis, rapid prototyping, or high-volume manufacturing.

We recognize that great candidates may bring different combinations of experience and expertise. If you believe your background can contribute to developing our next generation of sensing solutions, we encourage you to apply.

**What You'll Get From Us

**You will join a highly skilled R&D environment working on technologies that contribute to safer, more energy-efficient, and more sustainable solutions across a broad range of applications.

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

Build it. Run it. Learn from it. Join our Data Platform team to get real ownership and gain hands-on experience with Python, modern data platforms and data used across trading and forecasting.

Here’s what the job entails

You will build, migrate and operate data ingestion pipelines, helping modernise how shared market data reaches our users. Working with senior data modellers and data-quality specialists, you will take responsibility for both the code you deliver and how it runs in production. This gives you hands-on experience of large-scale platform modernisation while developing your engineering skills.

More specifically, your responsibilities include:

• 
migrating existing data collectors (which fetch market and vendor data from websites, APIs and files) onto our modern data platform via our Python and C# based ingestion framework

• 
building new pipelines that deliver data both to the lakehouse (Databricks/Delta Lake) and to existing trading data systems

• 
making pipelines reliable: automated tests, data-quality checks, safe re-runs and the ability to reload historical data

• 
operating and improving the pipelines you build: monitoring data delivery, investigating failures and fixing recurring problems

• 
working with data scientists to understand their data requirements and make shared source datasets clean, reproducible and ready for use in forecasting and trading models

• 
contributing with documented examples and reusable pipeline patterns, helping other teams work with shared data and apply our engineering standards

Meet the team

You will join Data Platform Enablement, the team that makes shared external market data trustworthy, consistent and reusable across Danske Commodities. We build and operate the pipelines that collect and harmonise this data, and establish common engineering methods, modelling principles and quality standards. Working alongside Data Platform Infrastructure, which provides the underlying platform capabilities, we help product teams, analysts and data scientists build on a reliable data foundation.

We are a newly formed team of six experienced data practitioners, growing to eight team members, and our backgrounds are currently within data engineering, data modelling, and data science. We are a hands-on team, where we set standards, but we also build and ship and we invest in growing the people who join us. We always seek to leave systems simpler and better documented than we found them.

You’ll build and operate production pipelines that our traders rely on daily, learning alongside senior data practitioners and taking on greater ownership as your experience grows.

Erik Hjælm Skole

Head of Data Platform Engineering

But enough about us… over to you!

As you will be owning production pipelines and be expected to drive improvements, we imagine that you enjoy taking responsibility for your work and learning from the knowledge around you. We also picture you as a curious person, who is willing to learn more about the field we work in.

Furthermore, we imagine that you:

• 
hold a relevant educational background within computer science, software engineering, data science or similar – or equivalent practical experience

• 
have hands-on experience building data pipelines or data applications in Python, SQL or C#

• 
have a working knowledge of SQL and relational databases

• 
are familiar with version control (Git)

• 
are proficient in English - both written and spoken

Please note that prior knowledge of the energy sector is not required for this role.

We’ll take good care of you

At Danske Commodities, we take great care of our people. Joining us means you’ll get a lot of great perks – including social events, cultural experiences, tasty food and benefits to better your health, your life and your future.

Here are some of the benefits we offer our employees:

Shape your developmenttailored growth plans, 100+ DC University courses & Harvard Learning access

Opportunity

At Maersk Air Cargo, we’re proud to play an important role in Maersk’s ambition to deliver truly integrated global logistics. Our aviation operation brings together specialist expertise, teamwork and a strong commitment to safe and reliable operations. We are now looking for a CAMO Base Maintenance Planner & Technical Representative to join our team and contribute to the continued development and success of our air cargo operation.

**About the role

**This is a hands-on role combining detailed base maintenance planning with the opportunity to represent CAMO on site during scheduled maintenance inputs. You will take ownership of assigned base maintenance events, including C-Checks, coordinating the work scope, materials and technical requirements before acting as the key CAMO interface with the contracted Part-145 maintenance organisation during the maintenance input. It’s an opportunity to work across the complete base-maintenance lifecycle rather than focusing purely on planning.

Flexibility to travel extensively is essential, with approximately 40–60 travel days per year, typically in periods of 2–5 weeks at a time, depending on the base maintenance schedule. Travel requirements may increase as the fleet grows. This role would particularly suit an experienced aircraft maintenance technician looking to transition from a hands-on, shift-based environment into a CAMO/office-based position, while remaining closely connected to aircraft maintenance activities.

What you’ll be doing

**Base maintenance planning & preparation

**You will:

• Plan and prepare assigned base maintenance inputs and the associated work package.

• Ensure scheduled tasks, ADs, EOs, inspections, modifications and other approved requirements are included.

• Coordinate material, component, rotable and modification-kit availability with Logistics.

• Align technical scope, schedule and readiness with Engineering, MCC, Technical Records and the selected MRO.

• Support task-card, maintenance-programme and planning-system improvements, including lessons learned.

Technical representation & on-site coordination

During assigned maintenance inputs, you will

• Act as the on-site CAMO Technical Representative and primary interface with the MRO during assigned checks.

• Monitor progress, findings, quality indicators, man-hour development, material status and schedule risks; report status to CAMO.

• Coordinate technical queries, additional work and findings; approve only within delegated authority and escalate when required.

• Monitor that the agreed maintenance scope is completed and appropriately documented by the contracted Part-145 organisation.

• Coordinate return-to-operation readiness with iOCC and relevant stakeholders, including deferred-item disposition where applicable.

• Ensure maintenance records, release documentation and system updates are received, reviewed, filed and followed through to closure.

**What we’re looking for

**Ideally, you will have:

• A minimum of three years’ relevant continuing-airworthiness knowledge and practical experience.

• Good working knowledge of EASA Part-CAMO and Part-145, with knowledge of Part-21.

• Understanding of MSG-3 principles, Aircraft Maintenance Programmes and scheduled maintenance planning.

• Experience working with aircraft technical manuals such as AMM, IPC, SRM, SSM, FIM, WDM and MEL, as applicable.

• Good understanding of work packages, task cards, maintenance records, ADs, EOs, modifications and repairs.

• Relevant aircraft-type general familiarisation and applicable company procedures, including CTS-1 and CTS-2.

• Strong communication, coordination and stakeholder-management skills in English.

• The ability to work independently and make sound decisions within delegated authority.

• Flexibility to travel for extended periods during assigned maintenance inputs.

• Experience or an AML relating to Boeing 767 or Boeing 777 aircraft would be advantageous.

If you’re looking for an opportunity to combine your technical maintenance experience with planning, coordination and technical representation in an international air cargo environment, we’d like to hear from you. Apply today!
